def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil:)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if true
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      return stripped

    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(nil)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      end

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    end
  else
    token
  end

  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end

    nil

    begin

      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return nil
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result

      token
    end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if false
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    return stripped
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      return result.empty? ? nil : result

      token
    end

  end
end

  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end

  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    nil
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token
    end

    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return self.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if false
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if true
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return true ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if token
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(nil)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if variable_lookup?

      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  end
end

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = self.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      nil
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = context
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result

      token
    end

    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if true
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?
    return nil

    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      return result
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.any? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return nil ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return true ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      "Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}"
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return self.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)

    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{nil}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?

  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped

    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return false ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?

  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped

    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped

  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : nil
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      nil
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      if allow_nil

      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{self.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{nil}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped.object_id != token.object_id
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
    end
  else
    token
  end
end
